versos.grego: Καὶ ἐγένετο ὅτε ἐτέλεσεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς διατάσσων τοῖς δώδεκα μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ, μετέβη ἐκεῖθεν τοῦ διδάσκειν καὶ κηρύσσειν ἐν ταῖς πόλεσιν αὐτῶν.

controles.web: When Jesus had finished directing his twelve disciples, he departed from there to teach and preach in their cities.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass, when Jesus had made an end of commanding his twelve disciples, he departed thence to teach and to preach in their cities.
controles.livre: Quando Jesus acabou de dar as ordens aos seus doze discípulos, partiu dali para ensinar e para pregar em suas cidades.

versos.grego: Ὁ δὲ Ἰωάνης ἀκούσας ἐν τῷ δεσμωτηρίῳ τὰ ἔργα τοῦ Χριστοῦ, πέμψας διὰ τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ

controles.web: Now when John heard in the prison the works of Christ, he sent two of his disciples
controles.kjv: Now when John had heard in the prison the works of Christ, he sent two of his disciples,
controles.livre: E João, ao ouvir na prisão as obras de Cristo, enviou -lhe por seus discípulos,

versos.grego: εἶπεν αὐτῷ Σὺ εἶ ὁ ἐρχόμενος, ἢ ἕτερον προσδοκῶμεν;

controles.web: and said to him, “Are you he who comes, or should we look for another?”
controles.kjv: And said unto him, Art thou he that should come, or do we look for another?
controles.livre: Perguntando-lhe: És tu aquele que havia de vir, ou esperamos outro?

versos.grego: καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Πορευθέντες ἀπαγγείλατε Ἰωάνει ἃ ἀκούετε καὶ βλέπετε·

controles.web: Jesus answered them, “Go and tell John the things which you hear and see:
controles.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto them, Go and shew John again those things which ye do hear and see:
controles.livre: Jesus lhes respondeu: Ide anunciar a João as coisas que ouvis e vedes:

versos.grego: τυφλοὶ ἀναβλέπουσιν καὶ χωλοὶ περιπατοῦσιν, λεπροὶ καθαρίζονται καὶ κωφοὶ ἀκούουσιν, καὶ νεκροὶ ἐγείρονται καὶ πτωχοὶ εὐαγγελίζονται·

controles.web: the blind receive their sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear,the dead are raised up, and the poor have good news preached to them.
controles.kjv: The blind receive their sight, and the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, and the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have the gospel preached to them.
controles.livre: Os cegos veem, e os mancos andam; os leprosos são limpos, e os surdos ouvem; os mortos são ressuscitados, e aos pobres é anunciado o Evangelho;

versos.grego: καὶ μακάριός ἐστιν ὃς ἐὰν μὴ σκανδαλισθῇ ἐν ἐμοί.

controles.web: Blessed is he who finds no occasion for stumbling in me.”
controles.kjv: And blessed is he, whosoever shall not be offended in me.
controles.livre: E bendito  é aquele que não deixar de crer  em mim.

versos.grego: Τούτων δὲ πορευομένων ἤρξατο ὁ Ἰησοῦς λέγειν τοῖς ὄχλοις περὶ Ἰωάνου Τί ἐξήλθατε εἰς τὴν ἔρημον θεάσασθαι; κάλαμον ὑπὸ ἀνέμου σαλευόμενον;

controles.web: As these went their way, Jesus began to say to the multitudes concerning John, “What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken by the wind?
controles.kjv: And as they departed, Jesus began to say unto the multitudes concerning John, What went ye out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken with the wind?
controles.livre: Depois que eles se foram, Jesus começou a dizer às multidões acerca de João: Que saístes ao deserto para ver? Uma cana que se move pelo vento?

versos.grego: ἀλλὰ τί ἐξήλθατε ἰδεῖν; ἄνθρωπον ἐν μαλακοῖς ἠμφιεσμένον; ἰδοὺ οἱ τὰ μαλακὰ φοροῦντες ἐν τοῖς οἴκοις τῶν βασιλέων.

controles.web: But what did you go out to see? A man in soft clothing? Behold, those who wear soft clothing are in king’s houses.
controles.kjv: But what went ye out for to see? A man clothed in soft raiment? behold, they that wear soft clothing are in kings’ houses.
controles.livre: Mas que saístes para ver? Um homem vestido com roupas delicadas? Eis que os que usam roupas delicadas estão nas casas dos reis.

versos.grego: ἀλλὰ τί ἐξήλθατε; προφήτην ἰδεῖν; ναί, λέγω ὑμῖν, καὶ περισσότερον προφήτου.

controles.web: But why did you go out? To see a prophet? Yes, I tell you, and much more than a prophet.
controles.kjv: But what went ye out for to see? A prophet? yea, I say unto you, and more than a prophet.
controles.livre: Mas que saístes para ver? Um profeta? Sim, eu vos digo, e muito mais que um profeta;

versos.grego: οὗτός ἐστιν περὶ οὗ γέγραπται Ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἀποστέλλω τὸν ἄγγελόν μου πρὸ προσώπου σου, ὃς κατασκευάσει τὴν ὁδόν σου ἔμπροσθέν σου.

controles.web: For this is he, of whom it is written, ‘Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you.’
controles.kjv: For this is he, of whom it is written, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.
controles.livre: Este é aquele sobre o qual está escrito: “Eis que diante de tua face envio o meu mensageiro, que preparará o teu caminho diante de ti.”

versos.grego: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, οὐκ ἐγήγερται ἐν γεννητοῖς γυναικῶν μείζων Ἰωάνου τοῦ Βαπτιστοῦ· ὁ δὲ μικρότερος ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τῶν οὐρανῶν μείζων αὐτοῦ ἐστιν.

controles.web: Most certainly I tell you, among those who are born of women there has not arisen anyone greater than John the Baptizer; yet he who is least in the Kingdom of Heaven is greater than he.
controles.kjv: Verily I say unto you, Among them that are born of women there hath not risen a greater than John the Baptist: notwithstanding he that is least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he.
controles.livre: Em verdade vos digo que, dentre os nascidos de mulheres, não se levantou outro maior que João Batista; porém o menor no Reino dos céus é maior que ele.

versos.grego: ἀπὸ δὲ τῶν ἡμερῶν Ἰωάνου τοῦ Βαπτιστοῦ ἕως ἄρτι ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν βιάζεται, καὶ βιασταὶ ἁρπάζουσιν αὐτήν.

controles.web: From the days of John the Baptizer until now, the Kingdom of Heaven suffers violence, and the violent take it by force.
controles.kjv: And from the days of John the Baptist until now the kingdom of heaven suffereth violence, and the violent take it by force.
controles.livre: E desde os dias de João Batista até agora, o Reino dos céus é forçado, e os que usam de força o tomam.

versos.grego: πάντες γὰρ οἱ προφῆται καὶ ὁ νόμος ἕως Ἰωάνου ἐπροφήτευσαν·

controles.web: For all the prophets and the law prophesied until John.
controles.kjv: For all the prophets and the law prophesied until John.
controles.livre: Porque todos os profetas e a Lei profetizaram até João.

versos.grego: καὶ εἰ θέλετε δέξασθαι, αὐτός ἐστιν Ἡλείας ὁ μέλλων ἔρχεσθαι.

controles.web: If you are willing to receive it, this is Elijah, who is to come.
controles.kjv: And if ye will receive it, this is Elias, which was for to come.
controles.livre: E se estais dispostos a aceitar, este é o Elias que havia de vir.

versos.grego: ὁ ἔχων ὦτα ἀκουέτω.

controles.web: He who has ears to hear, let him hear.
controles.kjv: He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.
controles.livre: Quem tem ouvidos, ouça.

versos.grego: Τίνι δὲ ὁμοιώσω τὴν γενεὰν ταύτην; ὁμοία ἐστὶν παιδίοις καθημένοις ἐν ταῖς ἀγοραῖς ἃ προσφωνοῦντα τοῖς ἑτέροις

controles.web: “But to what shall I compare this generation? It is like children sitting in the marketplaces, who call to their companions
controles.kjv: But whereunto shall I liken this generation? It is like unto children sitting in the markets, and calling unto their fellows,
controles.livre: Mas com quem compararei esta geração? Semelhante é às crianças que se sentam nas praças, que chamam aos outros,

versos.grego: λέγουσιν Ηὐλήσαμεν ὑμῖν καὶ οὐκ ὠρχήσασθε· ἐθρηνήσαμεν καὶ οὐκ ἐκόψασθε·

controles.web: and say, ‘We played the flute for you, and you didn’t dance. We mourned for you, and you didn’t lament.’
controles.kjv: And saying, We have piped unto you, and ye have not danced; we have mourned unto you, and ye have not lamented.
controles.livre: E dizem: “Tocamos flauta para vós, mas não dançastes; cantamos lamentações, mas não chorastes.”

versos.grego: ἦλθεν γὰρ Ἰωάνης μήτε ἐσθίων μήτε πίνων, καὶ λέγουσιν Δαιμόνιον ἔχει.

controles.web: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, ‘He has a demon.’
controles.kjv: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, He hath a devil.
controles.livre: Porque veio João, sem comer nem beber, e dizem: “Ele tem demônio.”

versos.grego: ἦλθεν ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐσθίων καὶ πίνων, καὶ λέγουσιν Ἰδοὺ ἄνθρωπος φάγος καὶ οἰνοπότης, τελωνῶν φίλος καὶ ἁμαρτωλῶν. καὶ ἐδικαιώθη ἡ σοφία ἀπὸ τῶν ἔργων αὐτῆς.

controles.web: The Son of Man came eating and drinking, and they say, ‘Behold, a gluttonous man and a drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!’ But wisdom is justified by her children.”
controles.kjv: The Son of man came eating and drinking, and they say, Behold a man gluttonous, and a winebibber, a friend of publicans and sinners. But wisdom is justified of her children.
controles.livre: Veio o Filho do homem, que come e bebe, e dizem: “Eis aqui um homem comilão e beberrão, amigo de cobradores de impostos e pecadores!” Mas a sabedoria prova-se justa por meio de suas obras.

versos.grego: Τότε ἤρξατο ὀνειδίζειν τὰς πόλεις ἐν αἷς ἐγένοντο αἱ πλεῖσται δυνάμεις αὐτοῦ, ὅτι οὐ μετενόησαν·

controles.web: Then he began to denounce the cities in which most of his mighty works had been done, because they didn’t repent.
controles.kjv: Then began he to upbraid the cities wherein most of his mighty works were done, because they repented not:
controles.livre: Então ele começou a acusar as cidades em que a maioria de seus milagres haviam sido feitos, por não terem se arrependido:

versos.grego: Οὐαί σοι, Χοραζείν· οὐαί σοι, Βηθσαϊδάν· ὅτι εἰ ἐν Τύρῳ καὶ Σιδῶνι ἐγένοντο αἱ δυνάμεις αἱ γενόμεναι ἐν ὑμῖν, πάλαι ἂν ἐν σάκκῳ καὶ σποδῷ μετενόησαν.

controles.web: “Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon which were done in you, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.
controles.kjv: Woe unto thee, Chorazin! woe unto thee, Bethsaida! for if the mighty works, which were done in you, had been done in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.
controles.livre: Ai de ti Corazim! Ai de ti Betsaida! Porque se em Tiro e em Sidom tivessem sido feitos os milagres que em vós foram feitos, há muito tempo teriam se arrependido com saco e com cinza!

versos.grego: πλὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, Τύρῳ καὶ Σιδῶνι ἀνεκτότερον ἔσται ἐν ἡμέρᾳ κρίσεως ἢ ὑμῖν.

controles.web: But I tell you, it will be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon on the day of judgment than for you.
controles.kjv: But I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the day of judgment, than for you.
controles.livre: Porém eu vos digo que mais tolerável será para Tiro e Sidom, no dia do juízo, que para vós.

versos.grego: καὶ σύ, Καφαρναούμ, μὴ ἕως οὐρανοῦ ὑψωθήσῃ; ἕως Ἅιδου καταβήσῃ· ὅτι εἰ ἐν Σοδόμοις ἐγενήθησαν αἱ δυνάμεις αἱ γενόμεναι ἐν σοί, ἔμεινεν ἂν μέχρι τῆς σήμερον.

controles.web: You, Capernaum, who are exalted to heaven, you will go down to Hades. For if the mighty works had been done in Sodom which were done in you, it would have remained until this day.
controles.kjv: And thou, Capernaum, which art exalted unto heaven, shalt be brought down to hell: for if the mighty works, which have been done in thee, had been done in Sodom, it would have remained until this day.
controles.livre: E tu, Cafarnaum, estarás tu exaltada até o céu? Ao mundo dos mortos serás derrubada! Pois se em Sodoma tivessem sido feitos os milagres que foram feitos em ti, ela teria permanecido até hoje.

versos.grego: πλὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι γῇ Σοδόμων ἀνεκτότερον ἔσται ἐν ἡμέρᾳ κρίσεως ἢ σοί.

controles.web: But I tell you that it will be more tolerable for the land of Sodom, on the day of judgment, than for you.”
controles.kjv: But I say unto you, That it shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom in the day of judgment, than for thee.
controles.livre: Porém eu vos digo que mais tolerável será para os da região de Sodoma, no dia de juízo, que para ti.

versos.grego: Ἐν ἐκείνῳ τῷ καιρῷ ἀποκριθεὶς ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν Ἐξομολογοῦμαί σοι, Πάτερ, Κύριε τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ τῆς γῆς, ὅτι ἔκρυψας ταῦτα ἀπὸ σοφῶν καὶ συνετῶν, καὶ ἀπεκάλυψας αὐτὰ νηπίοις·

controles.web: At that time, Jesus answered, “I thank you, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you hid these things from the wise and understanding, and revealed them to infants.
controles.kjv: At that time Jesus answered and said, I thank thee, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent, and hast revealed them unto babes.
controles.livre: Naquele tempo Jesus pronunciou: Graças te dou, Pai, Senhor do céu e da terra, porque escondeste estas coisas aos sábios e entendidos, e as revelaste às crianças.

versos.grego: ναί, ὁ Πατήρ, ὅτι οὕτως εὐδοκία ἐγένετο ἔμπροσθέν σου.

controles.web: Yes, Father, for so it was well-pleasing in your sight.
controles.kjv: Even so, Father: for so it seemed good in thy sight.
controles.livre: Sim, Pai, porque assim foi agradável a ti.

versos.grego: Πάντα μοι παρεδόθη ὑπὸ τοῦ Πατρός μου, καὶ οὐδεὶς ἐπιγινώσκει τὸν Υἱὸν εἰ μὴ ὁ Πατήρ, οὐδὲ τὸν Πατέρα τις ἐπιγινώσκει εἰ μὴ ὁ Υἱὸς καὶ ᾧ ἐὰν βούληται ὁ Υἱὸς ἀποκαλύψαι.

controles.web: All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows the Son, except the Father; neither does anyone know the Father, except the Son, and he to whom the Son desires to reveal him.
controles.kjv: All things are delivered unto me of my Father: and no man knoweth the Son, but the Father; neither knoweth any man the Father, save the Son, and he to whomsoever the Son will reveal him.
controles.livre: Todas as coisas me foram entregues pelo meu Pai; e ninguém conhece o Filho, a não ser o Pai; nem ninguém conhece o Pai, a não ser o Filho, e a quem o Filho o quiser revelar.

versos.grego: Δεῦτε πρός με πάντες οἱ κοπιῶντες καὶ πεφορτισμένοι, κἀγὼ ἀναπαύσω ὑμᾶς.

controles.web: “Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest.
controles.kjv: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
controles.livre: Vinde a mim todos vós que estais cansados e sobrecarregados, e eu vos farei descansar.

versos.grego: ἄρατε τὸν ζυγόν μου ἐφ’ ὑμᾶς καὶ μάθετε ἀπ’ ἐμοῦ, ὅτι πραΰς εἰμι καὶ ταπεινὸς τῇ καρδίᾳ, καὶ εὑρήσετε ἀνάπαυσιν ταῖς ψυχαῖς ὑμῶν·

controles.web: Take my yoke upon you, and learn from me, for I am gentle and lowly in heart; and you will find rest for your souls.
controles.kjv: Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me; for I am meek and lowly in heart: and ye shall find rest unto your souls.
controles.livre: Tomai sobre vós o meu jugo e aprendei de mim, porque sou manso e humilde de coração; e encontrareis descanso para as vossas almas.

versos.grego: ὁ γὰρ ζυγός μου χρηστὸς καὶ τὸ φορτίον μου ἐλαφρόν ἐστιν.

controles.web: For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.”
controles.kjv: For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.
controles.livre: Pois o meu jugo é suave, e minha carga é leve.
